meta.note: Qualitative mechanisms and mitigations; no invented probabilities.

rows.name: Lease-term erosion
rows.mechanism: Shorter remaining term can reduce buyer financing depth and increase renewal uncertainty even while rent is paid.
rows.mitigation: Start price discovery and extension discussions before the final marketing window; compare net proceeds, not headline price.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Tenant/operator default
rows.mechanism: The rent obligor may be a franchise entity, not the publicly traded franchisor; store sales and guarantor capacity are unknown.
rows.mitigation: Obtain rent roll, payment history, store P&L, guaranty and entity credit before relying on brand credit.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Renewal at lower rent or with concessions
rows.mechanism: Market-rate renewal can reset rent down; free rent, TI and landlord work reduce effective NOI.
rows.mitigation: Underwrite effective rent after concessions and compare with executable sale offers.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Vacancy and re-tenanting
rows.mechanism: Drive-thru use, zoning, parking, grease interceptor, ADA and building condition can constrain reuse and extend downtime.
rows.mitigation: Verify entitlements/access and obtain contractor/leasing estimates; stress 0/12/24-month downtime without assigning probabilities.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: NNN leakage
rows.mechanism: Roof/structure, parking, capital replacements, insurance gaps or environmental duties may remain with the landlord.
rows.mitigation: Read every lease clause and property-condition report; reserve for non-recoverable costs.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Cap-rate and financing shock
rows.mechanism: Higher required yields reduce value; buyer debt terms can change independently of property NOI.
rows.mitigation: Stress entry/exit caps and financing separately; keep liquidity for carry and avoid forced-sale timing.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Inflation above fixed escalators
rows.mechanism: Fixed bumps may lag operating costs and market rents; CPI is not automatically the lease escalator.
rows.mitigation: Compare contract escalator with cost exposure; negotiate resets only if economics justify it.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Labor and food-cost pressure
rows.mechanism: Higher wages and volatile food/energy costs can compress operator margins and rent coverage even if brand sales hold.
rows.mitigation: Review store-level coverage, pricing power and franchisee liquidity; do not infer from system AUV.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Concentration and liquidity
rows.mechanism: A single building, tenant and location cannot be diversified or sold instantly without transaction costs.
rows.mitigation: Set owner-level liquidity reserve and concentration limit; compare with genuinely executable alternatives.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Tax and exchange execution
rows.mechanism: ULA boundary, recapture, NIIT, debt relief and missed 1031 deadlines can materially reduce net proceeds.
rows.mitigation: Model jurisdiction-specific taxes and use qualified tax/exchange professionals before signing.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Environmental liability
rows.mechanism: Prior fuel/restaurant uses or nearby cleanup sites can create investigation, remediation and financing friction.
rows.mitigation: Phase I ESA, GeoTracker review and insurance/indemnity analysis; indemnity is only as strong as the obligor.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Construction and access disruption
rows.mechanism: Nearby transit/street work can temporarily alter visibility, parking and customer access; long-run transit benefits are site-specific.
rows.mitigation: Check current project notices and actual frontage/access before underwriting a location premium.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Public-realm and demand shifts
rows.mechanism: Crime, homelessness, office attendance, tourism and household budgets can affect a specific block differently from city averages.
rows.mitigation: Use current official neighborhood data and site visits; leave unavailable current counts blank.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Insurance cost and availability
rows.mechanism: Premiums, deductibles, exclusions and FAIR Plan-related surcharges can change NOI and financeability.
rows.mitigation: Bindable quotes, replacement-cost review, ordinance/law and business-interruption limits; stress non-recoverable premiums.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Earthquake and lifeline outage
rows.mechanism: Shaking, liquefaction, fault rupture or utility interruption can damage the building and stop sales even without total loss.
rows.mitigation: Site-specific seismic review, retrofit options, earthquake coverage and liquidity; do not convert regional odds into parcel loss.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Wind-driven wildfire / ember event
rows.mechanism: The 2025 fires show severe losses can occur beyond intuitive forest-edge locations; smoke and evacuation also interrupt business.
rows.mitigation: Parcel fire/ember review, hardening, insurance and continuity plan; no parcel probability assigned.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Extreme atmospheric-river flooding
rows.mechanism: ARkStorm illustrates correlated property damage, business interruption and weeks-to-months lifeline restoration.
rows.mitigation: Flood mapping, drainage/elevation review, flood and BI coverage, emergency liquidity; scenario is not an annual forecast.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Franchisee or supply-chain failure
rows.mechanism: Operator bankruptcy, payment deferrals, food-safety event or distributor failure can interrupt rent and brand demand.
rows.mitigation: Tenant financial surveillance, guaranty review, guarantor diversification and lease-remedy analysis.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Debt/capital-market freeze
rows.mechanism: Refinancing may be unavailable or expensive at the owner or tenant level precisely when sale bids are weak.
rows.mitigation: Stagger maturities, avoid near-term forced sales, maintain reserves and test covenant/headroom scenarios.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.

rows.name: Correlated regional shock
rows.mechanism: Trade disruption, entertainment contraction, disaster and fiscal stress can hit demand, costs and exit liquidity together.
rows.mitigation: Use combined downside scenarios rather than treating every risk as independent; preserve optionality.
rows.note: Analyst risk pathway; no parcel-specific probability or loss estimate.
